entries.3efb8fd7d1ed452b: The main business, covering everything from mining of raw bentonite ore to manufacturing and sale of bentonite products for foundry use (shaped materials), civil engineering and construction, pet litter and other uses. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,842 million, accounting for about 7 tenths of consolidated sales. Mining of raw ore is carried out by Kunimain Co., Ltd., Kawasaki Mining Co., Ltd. and Kanben Mining Co., Ltd., while the company carries out manufacturing and sales as well as purchase and sale of mud conditioners and various research and analysis. Kunimine Marketing Co., Ltd. mainly operates distribution centers, and KUNIMINE(THAILAND)CO.,LTD. purchases and sells bentonite for shaped materials.
